admission_gates.cross_host_protocol: interrupted on CPU conflict; fresh versioned probe required
admission_gates.console_independent_user_services: Cabbage Linger=no; enable and verify at authorized admission

launch_design.service: New systemd user service; Type=exec, Restart=no, KillMode=control-group, Nice=19, CPUAffinity=0-15, TimeoutStopSec=8s; RuntimeMaxSec computed from the fixed deadline with cleanup margin.
launch_design.timer: Independent one-shot user timer to stop the new service at 2026-11-09 14:59:50 UTC. No existing service is stopped or changed.
launch_design.prelaunch: Reverify manifest and physical topology, idle CPU/GPU, actual adapter/mount/private ownership, both cross-host PASS files, refreshed disjoint common-ledger claim and aggregate disk headroom. Then freeze a fresh config and collector identity.
launch_design.rollback: On failure stop only the new Cabbage service and its owned processes; preserve its journal and source identity. Do not resume an old journal with changed code or erase durable reservation history. No automatic restart.
launch_design.user_linger: Required before launch: authorized loginctl enable-linger pnord; no setting was changed by preparation.

limitations: The snapshot range proposal is not a current production allocation or storage reservation.
The staged source identity is tested; the final production config and its claim/collector fingerprint are not yet created.
Cross-host protocol and Ada publisher require the Ada-side owner; no remote Ada commands were run.
